name: HERMES_NEWS_BRIDGE_WINDOW_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_NEWS_BRIDGE_WINDOW_20261107 — LQ-20261107-112: hermes-news-bridge exited 0 with no_new_input
on every run from 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-07 while news_articles source='hermes' gained nothing, because its
upstream momentum_catalyst feed had died and a per-run zero is a legitimately allowed empty. The lane now
reads its own contract window (per_window 48 h, min_produced 1) from the output store and fails with
no_input_in_window — or window_unreadable when the count itself cannot be read, never a silent zero.
Hermetic: fake cursor, no database, no network, synthetic symbols.
